about: Nahum tells that God is good and keeps His people safe, and that cruel Nineveh would fall.

pages.title: A Safe Place
pages.scene: Strong walls of an old city
pages.text: Nineveh had become cruel again. It hurt many nations. Nahum said, "The Lord is good. He is a safe place in times of trouble. He takes care of those who trust Him." God would stop the cruel city.
pages.lesson: God is a safe place when you're in trouble.
